scripts.api:generate: openapi-typescript openapi/order-api.json -o src/features/orders/api/generated.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/catalog-api-v2.json -o src/features/catalog/api/generated.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/identity-api.json -o src/features/access/api/generated.ts
